Namespace
ConduitNet

Typed accessor for Conduit. Use with a using alias for convenience:

using Net = ConduitNet.Conduit<MyLobbyState, MyProfile, MyAccount>;

Then access typed properties directly: Net.LocalUser.Profile, Net.Lobby.State
